conclusions: GET_INTERFACE EPIPE was retained; no explicit setter was attempted in that getter-based run. Temporal degradation does not identify the getter as the natural root cause.

The descriptor-qualified interface0/alt0 setter on port3 returned zero, but both subsequent real configuration reads returned EPROTO. No HCC route or module was attempted; nominal setter success was not recovery.

The guest-resets-all enumeration contrast made five actual resets and a host address change. It was rejected as a production strategy; the replacement laboratory option defaults off and consumes before at most one reset per object.

The port4 once-budget run recorded one reset, readonly budget=true, two real guest ROM endpoints and bcdDevice1.00. The runtime-only maintenance probe correctly failed. Its launcher lost qemu_exit on a shutdown BrokenPipe; guest sealed failure/capture and poweroff evidence were preserved, not rewritten to success.

The port1 once-budget run recorded one reset, remained five-endpoint runtime and timed out on the reference36-byte queue10 EP01 OUT. Port4 ROM appearance is not a universal recovery or a proven causal chain.

A subsequent normal one-vCPU VM, with all reset/detach opt-outs false, recognized port4 ROM but failed at its first READM OUT with phase1=LOADING, error=-110, uploads1, metadata unavailable. No firmware upload, Setup or Managed case completed; the peer was not attached before failure.

Private one-shot physical SET_CONFIGURATION1 forwarding on port1 really returned libusb rc0, but reference EP01 OUT still timed out. The candidate was not integrated into production; mutable build source was restored, while the exact private patch, binary/source and failure artifacts were preserved.
Live re-enumeration persistence of the once budget and active Ready peer isolation remain unqualified. Counted dependencies prove source behavior, not physical device or scheduler acceptance.

Historical real dual-device RF evidence and production Linux/Rust path remain unchanged. Requested Managed queue release/last-fd/dup and partial/in-flight matrix remains next priority after genuine independent Setup/Ready; no issue may close from these contrasts.
